sql_reading_A.note: "subjects in the Mathematics department" = subject department itself
sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH math_subjects AS (
    SELECT
        c.SUBJECT_CODE,
        c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        c.TOTAL_UNITS,
        c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
        o.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
        ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
       AND s.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED o
        ON o.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
       AND o.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
      AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    TOTAL_UNITS,
    IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
        ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE
    ) AS ROW_NUM
FROM math_subjects;

sql_reading_B.note: "subjects in the Mathematics department" = subjects whose offering department is Mathematics.
sql_reading_B.sql:
WITH math_subjects AS (
    SELECT
        c.SUBJECT_CODE,
        c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        c.TOTAL_UNITS,
        c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
        o.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
        ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
       AND s.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED o
        ON o.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
       AND o.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    WHERE o.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
      AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    TOTAL_UNITS,
    IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
        ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE
    ) AS ROW_NUM
FROM math_subjects;

question_text: For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), what is the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for subjects in the Mathematics department with a total of 12 units offered in the fall term, what are the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code? Show the department name and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) first, followed by the Mathematics subject details as available for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
